config.selection: strictly greatest valid macro_f1; earliest tie; test only after selection
config.primary_mechanism: mean test CE(shuffled_context_weights)-CE(actual); all samples, including short context
config.replication: Not automatic. Audit discovery first; fresh29/53/71/97/113 only after explicit release.
config.claim_scope: frozen encoder output head; not Transformer internal attention, SOTA, quantum speedup or exclusivity

data_limitations: Sentence and entity-surface overlaps are correlations, not proof of contamination or document disjointness.
Shared input hashes require explicit interpretation before qualification; official splits are preserved.
No tokenizer, frozen encoder, learnability, model test, training or efficacy evidence is produced.
Input construction must whitelist tokens/ordered spans; metadata and labels never enter encoder features.
